package.description: The Cline coding agent as a native desktop application.

en-US.description: The Cline coding agent as a native desktop application.
en-US.longDescription: Cline for Desktop is a standalone native desktop application of the Cline coding agent. It lets users open a workspace, converse with an AI agent to plan and execute coding tasks, queue follow-up messages, fork and edit conversations, and browse session history across desktop, CLI, extension, and scheduled runs. Users can bring their own API keys from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini, or sign in with a Cline account.
en-US.name: Cline

zh-CN.description: 以原生桌面应用形式呈现的 Cline 编程智能体。
zh-CN.longDescription: Cline 桌面版是 Cline 编程智能体的独立原生桌面应用。用户可以打开工作区，与 AI 智能体对话以规划和执行编码任务，排队追加消息，分叉和编辑会话，并浏览桌面、CLI、扩展和定时运行的历史会话。用户可以使用 Anthropic、OpenAI、Gemini 等供应商提供的自己的 API 密钥，或登录 Cline 账号。
